## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 390 captures during March 2023. Activity was delivered through the planned sessions, with session lists running as expected apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that capture activity continued without reported disruption. The total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 390 captures, 19 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.9. These images could not be used for grading and should remain a focus of routine quality review. Continued attention to image acquisition and capture technique may help support consistent image quality across future sessions.

## Grading

A total of 98 captures were recorded as referable. The median grading lag was 2. This provides an overview of grading timeliness alongside the monthly activity and image quality measures. Results should be considered together with the ungradable cases when reviewing the operation of the service at Market Eye Clinic during March 2023.
